licencia_incluida: GUARDIANA ZERO comes with the GUARDIANA subscription: the same key works for both programs. The first 7 days are free, with no card, and they count separately from GUARDIANA’s.

licencia_al_terminar: If there is no subscription when it ends, GUARDIANA ZERO will keep opening pages, but without its protection: it will not cut trackers, advertising or data brokers, clean addresses, watch your marked data, or make mandates or redactions. Only the web engine’s basic protection will remain, the same as Microsoft Edge’s. Nothing is charged.
licencia_periodo_0: Lifetime licence: paid once, it never expires. It ends only if the gateway says it is no longer valid, for example after a refund.
licencia_proxima: The key is checked again on {fecha}.
licencia_fallida: The key could not be checked (no connection to the gateway). It is tried again every hour; if it does not work before {fecha}, GUARDIANA ZERO will stop protecting until it does.
licencia_prueba_terminada: The trial ended on {fecha}. GUARDIANA ZERO still opens pages, but it no longer protects: it does not cut trackers, advertising or data brokers, clean addresses, watch your marked data, or make mandates or redactions. Only the web engine’s basic protection remains, the same as Microsoft Edge’s. What is already on your computer stays there.
licencia_terminada_cancelada: The payment gateway says the subscription ended on {fecha}, so GUARDIANA ZERO no longer protects. If it was a failed payment that you have since fixed, type your key again below.
licencia_terminada_sin_comprobar: The subscription could not be checked within the 7 days of grace, and on {fecha} GUARDIANA ZERO stopped protecting. It keeps trying every hour: as soon as the gateway answers that the key is valid, it protects again on its own.
licencia_terminada_rechazada: The gateway has said for 7 days that the key is not valid (after a refund, for example), so the licence ended on {fecha} and GUARDIANA ZERO no longer protects. If you think this is a mistake, write to us at hola@guardianagroup.com.
licencia_clave_explica: The key arrives by email when you pay; if you already use it in GUARDIANA, it is the same one. To activate it, GUARDIANA ZERO connects once to Dodo Payments, the payment gateway; after that it checks it 8 days later and once per billing period. Nothing else leaves your computer for the subscription, and every connection is listed below.
licencia_activando: Checking the key with the payment gateway…
licencia_activada: Subscription activated: GUARDIANA ZERO protects again.
licencia_hace_falta: This comes with the subscription: your trial is over.
licencia_conexiones_titulo: Connections GUARDIANA ZERO makes on its own
licencia_donde: The date the 7 days started is kept in two places on your computer: {datos} and {ancla}. That second mark also keeps the latest time the program has seen, so that turning the clock back does not stretch the trial. Nothing else. We say so because we hide nothing we do on your computer.
